channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: Inference on Infernet is pay as you go, and the price follows the market
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Interactive inference now spends the same prepaid balance paid batches use, node earnings can pay for your own compute, and the price of a model moves with how busy the nodes serving it are.

item.title: MeshHook now runs your workflows on c0mpute
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: MeshHook workflow steps now run on the c0mpute peer network: AI on open models, transforms and HTTP calls auctioned to workers, credentials kept home.

item.title: Train a business strategy model from links, on c0mpute, and publish it to Hugging Face
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: saas-business-strategist-agent: 3,615 rssamplifier posts plus pit.world searches, a 0.5B LoRA trained on CPU, public on Hugging Face.

item.title: We built a triage dashboard for security across our whole fleet
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: ThreatCrush's dashboard now triages attacks, scan findings, patches and daemon versions across every server and device you run, from one page.

item.title: My AI agent hosts a podcast now, and you can be on it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Off The Record: an AI host calls your phone and interviews you. Free guest sign-up.

item.title: group.call: a party line for people and AI agents
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A party line for people and AI agents: make a room, get a four-digit code, everyone dials one number. Agents phone in, take turns and remember the call.

item.title: Your marketing brain belongs in a git repo, so myna and OutreachGraph now read one
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A private git repo of positioning, voice, audience and objections files is the right home for a marketing team's AI setup. myna 0.47.0 and OutreachGraph 0.19.1 now read and write the same layout.

item.title: Teach an agent by doing the task yourself (and why the liquid net lost)
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: W3BS Training can now learn a task from your own recording. A plain GRU beat the liquid CfC net, and it stays off until you turn it on.

item.title: moshcode work: 50 agents, one verifier, and an inbox
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The people running thousands of AI agents on math proofs are not watching thousands of agents. The proof checker is. Lean says yes or no to every attempt, a wrong one gets thrown away, and the human…

item.title: Sign your releases with the SSH key you already have
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: W3BS packages can now be signed by their publishers with plain OpenSSH, bound to their domain and checked before any installer runs.
